desc:
Inspired by The Fantastic Four: First Steps movie, every cereal box is a limited edition collectable, featuring characters from the film; Collect all the boxes and crack hidden codes on the back. The taste of real honey and natural almond flavor in every delicious spoonful of gluten free sweetened whole grain oat cereal CAN HELP LOWER CHOLESTEROL as part of a heart healthy diet; 3g of soluble fiber daily from whole grain oat foods, in a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol, may reduce the risk of heart disease; Honey Nut Cheerios provides .75g per serving Pour it in a bowl with ice cold milk for an irresistible, gluten free part of an easy breakfast; Pack some up for gluten free snacks on the go, or add to homemade cereal bars

CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy Honey Nut Cheerios Heart Healthy Gluten Free Breakfast Cereal, Giant Size, 27.2 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Features

Delivers 22 grams of whole grain per serving to support a healthy diet.
Lightly sweetened with real honey for a delicious, wholesome taste.
Safe for those with gluten sensitivities—contains no wheat, barley, or rye.
Made with only natural ingredients and no synthetic additives.
Includes iron, vitamin D, B vitamins, and more to help meet daily nutritional needs.
A heart-smart choice for breakfast or snacking.
Stays crisp in milk while offering a pleasant crunch.

Benefits

Contains soluble fiber from whole grain oats, which may help reduce cholesterol as part of a healthy diet.
Loved by kids and adults alike for its lightly sweet, nutty flavor.
Offers a quick, easy way to get important nutrients into your morning routine.
Can be enjoyed with milk, as a dry snack, or used in recipes like cereal bars or snack mixes.
Low in fat and calories, making it suitable for mindful snacking.
A pantry staple for decades, known for its consistent quality and great taste.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Corn Starch, Honey, Brown Sugar Syrup, Salt, Tripotassium Phosphate, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Natural Almond Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
